description: Tailscale is a networking platform that creates private mesh networks for devices, users, and services. It provides tooling for managing tailnets, devices, policies, DNS, users, and related network administration.
summary: Tailscale exposes one documented developer integration surface on tailscale.com: a REST HTTP API at `https://api.tailscale.com/api/v2/`, authenticated with Tailscale-issued API access tokens or OAuth client credentials that mint short-lived access tokens.
